notes.title: A New Game from C Horse Games
notes.content:
Get Blueprint Bob HERE


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41558784/1212a1a2129c1f9431e3c8713ffcf04ec40a1415.png"]
Blueprint Bob is a physics based building puzzle game where you compete against other players on the leaderboards. There are 42 levels, over 30 different blocks, a level editor and ways to send your solutions to other playes.
